title: Kodiak recipe-card@v1 data contract
description: Versioned data contract for one monthly local-ingredient recipe card (gh #304). The object flows LLM-authoring hop -> renderer -> validation -> asset pack. Every field maps to a real source named below; no field permits fabrication — unknown values are explicit null plus a values_unknown entry, never a guess. The variant enum is provisional: gh #303 (variant taxonomy from the three dogfood images) is the future single source of truth; until it lands, the only implemented variant is hero-plus-layout, which is what src/creative_automation/recipe_card.py composes (text-free hero panel over a text-only layout panel, cr-1). The gateway recipe_card_plan tool returns a metadata projection of this contract carrying the same schema+variant markers. Distinct from the print-geometry template schema kodiak/recipe-card@v1 (references/templates/recipe-card.json), which describes physical page zones, not card data.

schema.description: Contract id. Emitted by build_recipe_card_data; the gateway plan carries the same marker.

variant.description: Card archetype. Provisional single value (the implemented two-layer hero-plus-layout composition); gh #303 owns the full taxonomy and may extend this enum — no orphan variants.

market.description: Registry market key the card was built for (e.g. US-SE-ATL). Source: caller request, must resolve in retailer-frontier-pairs.json.

frontier_market.description: Featured-frontier code the market resolves to (e.g. US-GA-SENOIA). Source: data/localization/market-featured-frontiers.json mapping; null when the market has no mapped frontier — never guessed.

ingredient.description: In-season local ingredient. Source: locales.resolve_this_month (single source of truth). Null marks the explicit no-ingredient result, which must also carry a non-empty reason.

recipe.description: Reference into data/recipes/kodiak-recipes.json by id — never inline-fabricated. Null only on the no-ingredient / no-catalog path.

name.description: The catalog record's real name, verbatim. The card title must equal this name.

month.description: Resolved ISO month the card was built for (YYYY-MM). Source: locales.resolve_this_month; null only when no pair is seeded.

season.description: Structured season the pairing resolved (spring|summer|fall|winter). Source: season_pairing.resolve_season via provenance.pairing; null when unresolvable.

lang.description: Language tag applying to every text block (title, ingredients, steps). Non-English blocks travel recipe_i18n machine translation with an allergen fail-safe; provenance.translation records providers and fallback lines.

title.description: Card title: the recipe's real catalog name (clean_brand_copy only). Null only on the no-ingredient path.

meta.description: Four-column meta bar. Each column comes ONLY from a real recipe field (prepTime/cookTime/yield/est_cost); missing backing fields are null and reported under provenance.values_unknown. est_cost and per-line prices appear only with a complete verified cost record.

ingredients.description: The matched recipe's real ingredient lines, verbatim from the catalog record (quantities included). price attaches only from a complete verified ingredient_costs record, else null.

steps.description: The recipe's real instructions, cleaned with the leading action word uppercased only — no cooking action is invented. Falls back to the recipe's ingredient lines like the PNG path.

sketch_zones.description: Art zones the renderer draws hand-drawn line-art into (raw_ingredient, technique, finished_plate). Source: recipe-card.json template zone ids.

seasonal_moment.description: Seeded seasonal moments attached as creative context (raw blocks from retailer-frontier-pairs.json: moment, available_ingredients, favorite_flavors, source, confidence, status, note). Never fabricated; [] when none seeded.

provenance.description: Source map for every fact on the card.

values_from_source.description: Facts confirmed via locales (e.g. the in-season ingredient).

values_proposed.description: Adaptations proposed by the generator (e.g. 'over Kodiak Power Cakes' framing).

values_unknown.description: Logical groups with no verified source (times, prices, nutrition, temperatures, serves) — rendered as absent/unknown, never guessed.

pairing.description: Why this recipe: season-indexed pairing provenance from pick_recipe_with_provenance.

translation.description: Present only on non-English cards: recipe_i18n providers, machine_translated/human_reviewed flags, allergen fallback lines.

art.description: Hand-drawn line-art URLs per sketch zone (Nova-Canvas seeded). Null per zone means fall back to the SVG placeholder — never a broken link.

substrate.description: Paper substrate key resolved from the template (default kraft). Source: references/templates/recipe-card.json substrates.

render.description: Render target metadata: canvas dimensions and which regions carry text vs stay text-free (image layer never carries baked-in words, cr-1). Dimensions source: recipe_card CARD_W/CARD_H/HERO_H constants.

reason.description: Present ONLY on the explicit no-ingredient / no-pair result (ingredient null, recipe null): the honest empty-state message. Never present alongside a picked recipe.
